readings: Group signals by `rfistat`, with signals that have no status (NULL) forming their own group, and ignore signals whose `modindex` is NULL. The benchmark is the overall average `modindex` across all individual signals that have a non-null `modindex`, so each signal counts equally. Keep only statuses whose average `modindex` is above that benchmark. For each, show the status, its average `modindex`, its excess over the benchmark (group average minus overall signal-level average), and its difference from the mean of the qualifying statuses' average `modindex` values (group average minus that mean). Leave all values unrounded.

Group signals by `rfistat`, with signals that have no status (NULL) forming their own group, and ignore signals whose `modindex` is NULL. Compute each status's average `modindex`. The benchmark is the unweighted mean of these per-status averages, across all statuses including the NULL group, so each status counts equally regardless of how many signals it has. Keep only statuses whose average is above that benchmark. For each, show the status, its average `modindex`, its excess over the benchmark (group average minus mean of all status averages), and its difference from the mean of the qualifying statuses' average `modindex` values (group average minus that mean). Leave all values unrounded.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS bench
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
q AS (
  SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, b.bench
  FROM g, b
  WHERE g.avg_mod > b.bench
)
SELECT rfistat,
       avg_mod AS avg_modindex,
       avg_mod - bench AS excess_over_benchmark,
       avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM q

WITH status_avg AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS bench FROM status_avg
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_mod, b.bench
  FROM status_avg s
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE s.avg_mod > b.bench
)
SELECT
  rfistat,
  avg_mod AS avg_modindex,
  avg_mod - bench AS excess_over_benchmark,
  avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying;
